3569.s: a Cushite, or descendant of Cush
t:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at Zep.1.1;
son of: Gedaliah (H1436H);
father of: Zephaniah (H6846H)
§ Cushi or Ethiopian, of Cush "their blackness"
1) one of the descendants of Cush the grandson of Noah through Ham and a member of that nation or people
2) one of Joab's couriers
3) (TWOT) Ethiopian

3570.s: Cushi, the name of two Israelites
t:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at Jer.36.14;
father of: Shelemiah (H8018K)
§ Cushi = "their blackness"
1) an ancestor of Jehudi (Jer. 36.14)
2) the father of the prophet Zephaniah (Zep. 1.1)

§ Cushan = "their blackness"
a place in Arabia or Mesopotamia

3573.d: apparently from H3572 (כּוּשָׁן) and the dual of H7564 (רִשְׁעָה); Cushan of double wickedness;
t:
A man living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jdg.3.8
§ Chushan-rishathaim = "twice-wicked Cushan"
a king of Mesopotamia defeated by the judge Othniel the son-in-law of Caleb

3575.s: Cuth or Cuthah, a province of Assyria
t:
§ Cuth = "crushing"
a place from which king Sargon of Assyria imported colonists into Israel; probably a location approx 20 (32 km) miles northeast of Babylon

3576.s: to lie (i.e. deceive), literally or figuratively
3576.k: fail, (be found a, make a) liar, lie, lying, be in vain.
t:
1) to lie, tell a lie, be a liar, be found a liar, be in vain, fail
1a) (Qal) liar (participle)
1b) (Niphal) to be proven to be lying
1c) (Piel)
1c1) to lie, tell a lie, tell a lie with, deceive
1c2) to disappoint, fail
1d) (Hiphil) to make a liar, prove to be a liar

3577.k: deceitful, false, leasing, + liar, lie, lying.
t: a lie, untruth, falsehood, deceptive thing

A woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.25.15;
daughter of: Zur (H6698)
§ Cozbi = "my lie"
a daughter of Zur, a chief of the Midianites, who was slain by Phinehas because of her adultery

3581.d: or (Daniel 11:6) ; from an unused root meaning to be firm;
3581.s: vigor, literally (force, in a good or a bad sense) or figuratively (capacity, means, produce); also (from its hardiness) a large lizard
3581.k: ability, able, chameleon, force, fruits, might, power(-ful), strength, substance, wealth.
t:
1) a small reptile, probably a kind of lizard, which is unclean
1a) perhaps an extinct animal, exact meaning is unknown

1) strength, power, might
1a) human strength
1b) strength (of angels)
1c) power (of God)
1d) strength (of animals)
1e) strength, produce, wealth (of soil)
u: now i beseech thee let the power

3582.s: to secrete, by act or word; hence (intensively) to destroy
t:
1) to hide, conceal, cut off, cut down, make desolate, kick
1a) (Niphal)
1a1) to be hidden
1a2) to be effaced, be destroyed, be cut off
1b) (Piel) to cover, hide
1c) (Hiphil)
1c1) to hide
1c2) to efface, annihilate

3584.s: to be untrue, in word (to lie, feign, disown) or deed (to disappoint, fail, cringe)
3584.k: deceive, deny, dissemble, fail, deal falsely, be found liars, (be-) lie, lying, submit selves.
t:
1) to deceive, lie, fail, grow lean, be disappointing, be untrue, be insufficient, be found liars, belie, deny, dissemble, deal falsely
1a) (Qal) to become lean
1b) (Niphal) to cringe, feign obedience
1c) (Piel)
1c1) to deceive, deny falsely
1c2) to act deceptively
1c3) to cringe
1c4) to disappoint, fail
1d) (Hithpael) to cringe, feign obedience

3585.s: literally a failure of flesh, i.e. emaciation; figuratively, hypocrisy

3588.d: a primitive particle (the full form of the prepositional prefix) indicating causal relations of all kinds, antecedent or consequent;
3588.s: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
3588.k: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.
t:
1) that, for, because, when, as though, as, because that, but, then, certainly, except, surely, since
1a) that
1a1) yea, indeed
1b) when (of time)
1b1) when, if, though (with a concessive force)
1c) because, since (causal connection)
1d) but (after negative)
1e) that if, for if, indeed if, for though, but if
1f) but rather, but
1g) except that
1h) only, nevertheless
1i) surely
1j) that is
1k) but if
1l) for though
1m) forasmuch as, for therefore

conj
forasmuch as, because that, because, notwithstanding, although

3589.d: from a primitive root meaning to strike;

3590.d: from the same as H3589 (כִּיד) (compare H3539 (כַּדְכֹּד));
3590.s: properly, something struck off, i.e. a spark (as struck)

3591.d: from the same as H3589 (כִּיד); (perhaps smaller than H2595 (חֲנִית)lemma חֲניִת second vowel, corrected to חֲנִית)
3591.s: properly, something to strike with, i.e. a dart
t:
1) javelin, short sword, dart
2) gorget, a piece of armour for the throat (1Sa 17.6)

3594.s: properly, a statue, i.e. idol; but used (by euphemism) forsome heathen deity (perhaps corresponding to Priapus or Baal-peor)
t:
§ Chiun = "an image" or "pillar"
probably a statue of the Assyrian-Babylonian god of the planet Saturn and used to symbolise Israelite apostasy

3595.d: or ; from the same as H3564 (כּוּר);
3595.s: properly, something round (as excavated or bored), i.e. a chafing-dish forcoals or a caldron forcooking; hence (from similarity of form) a washbowl; also (for the same reason) a pulpit or platform
t:
1) pot, basin, laver, pan
1a) pot, caldron
1b) fire-pot, brazier
1c) basin, laver
1d) platform, stage

3596.d: or ; from H3557 (כּוּל) in the sense of withholding;

3597.d: from an unused root meaning to clap or strike with noise;

3598.s: a cluster of stars, i.e. the Pleiades
t: Pleiades, a constellation of seven stars

3599.s: a cup; also a bag formoney or weights
